description: Block until a webhook inbox receives a request, then return the new requests. Pass after (the last request ID you have seen) to wait for newer ones only. Returns timedOut: true after timeoutSeconds (default 25, max 30); call again to keep waiting.

after.description: Optional request ID; only requests captured after it are returned.

token.description: Management or inspection token for anonymous resources. Omit for resources owned by your authenticated workspace.

name: wait_for_webhook
